[quote=pantagruel;60534153][spoiler=[b]Reorganization and shifts[/b]]

[i]With the withdrawal of Nordiheim and the Argossian militias from the lower islands, the UDF was swift to seize the territories and reorganize there. Now being positioned in between a Daesunesian leased military base in Maqamistan and the rest of Astanir, the UDF was in the perfect position to continue its island hopping offensive. But first, she'd lick her wounds. The fierce struggle with the Argossians left hundreds of UDF soldiers dead and depleted almost all of their current ordinance and ammo reserves. Over the next couple days, ammo shipments and medical supplies from third party unknown sources vaguely tracing to Daesun were delivered to the island, where UDF soldiers hospitalised their wounded and reloaded their armaments. Meanwhile, a multi-layered operation was conducted in search of missing in action combatants, decentralised search teams were dispatched to specific sectors of the islands to find their missing comrades, but if a soldier wasn't found after 7 days they'd be declared dead.

But even with surplus intermission, the UDF's search for its next victim continued. Northeast to the lower islands was a larger island controlled by the Restorationists which was suspected to be the faction's arms depot. Knowing their war machine needed more fuel, and had become more dependent on Daesun, the UDF decided after further discussion with Daesunesian high command and approval that their next military operations would be situated there. 

The first and essential phase for an attack on the restorationists was proper intelligence on the terrain, weapons situations, and positions. Which is what the UDF specialized in, over the next couple days, small surveillance drones were dispatched over the island in faint hordes, snapping instantaneous photos and videos of the island which would be up linked to the PDF and UDF high command. Though with such a short deadline, the UDF could only make blunt work of its captured intelligence. The next couple days were spent relaying this data with Daesun, whod translate it into missile launch coordinates for UDF ballistic missile systems stationed in the lower archipelago. Once codes were initialized and ready, the UDFs ballistic missile armada roared to life. Multiple Shahab-3 ballistic missile systems steamed their hatches open, releasing a volley of missiles towards restorationist military assets, positions, and general headquarters, 20 missiles soared across the clouds towards their targets, prowling with decisive speed. But the assault wasnt over yet, simultaneously, hundreds of suicide loitering drones zipped across the vast seas, saturating the Shahabs radar signature with their colossal hordes. These drones mainly focused on either precision strikes on aerial defences and political nodes, with their power coming in their sheer numbers. 

The UDFs focus was catching the restorationists off guard, to buy enough time for their amphibious assault force. Hundreds of marines seasoned from the fighting with the Argossian militias deployed towards the island in LCUs and LCACs, while also seeking an aerial escort of 3 Daesunesian F-15s, accompanied by another 6 F-18s. In total, over 3,500 soldiers headed towards the restorationist stronghold, ready for a battle that decisively ensured whether the UDF would succeed Astanir or not. Defeat was not an option, but a deterrent. 

Meanwhile, the UDF had also kept a keen eye on the current tableflip that was the rapidly shifting borders of mainland Astanir. Concerned by the rapid gains of Pax Intl, as well as the capturing of the capital, the UDF veered its head towards any potential beneficiary willing to combat Pax Intl expansion. One that caught the UDFs eye was isolationists, though a political contrast to the ideals of the UDF, the isolationists were their best bet to stalling off Pax Intl.  The UDF would reach out to the isolationists, offering military equipment such as ammo, anti-ship batteries, tanks, SAMs, and more. While requesting a temporary truce be signed between the two factions to establish a sort of common ground for their shared animosity for Pax Intl. The first efforts to flesh this out were in the form of invites to Teremok for negotiations and discussions. 

But for Teremok, her stake in the war seemed to be reckless and more decisive. The UDF still wasnt trustworthy enough to be able to function on its own without Daesunesian fostering, and so Daesun decided to privately take part in the UDFs assault on the restorationists. Eager to test out its new E/A-18G electronic warfare aircraft, an assault on the heavily armed restorationists was the perfect simulation for Daesun. In accordance with the UDF, Daesunesian E-18s flew from airbases in the lower archipelago towards the restorationist force, once within range, they utilized their electronic warfare specialized frame to turn the electronic battlefield into a conundrum of electronic noise, which aimed at further disorienting restorationist radars for the UDFs assault. The planes continued to loiter across the coast, defended by F-15s and F-18s orbiting them. [/i][/spoiler]
[/quote]

Images taken by drones above the stronghold island would clearly reveal the locations of arms depots, ports where ships could undergo repairs, key roads and other sites of military importance. The initial bombardment of daesunesian missiles would be very effective. The restorationists possessed no effective counter to such a high-tech threat. old air defence batteries would be brought to life, but their outdated targeting systems proved no match for the speed of the shahab-3. The restorationists would attempt to counter the drones by firing their coastal defences are the huge swarms, believing that such a large target would be easy to hit. Any surviving drones would then be shot down by snipers, situated on the coastal cliffs. Any drones that made it past the coast would be almost unmatched in their attacks. Small air defences situated at major supply depots would take aim and fire, but their slowness would likely cause them to miss the quick drones. Drone precision strikes would slowly begin to decimate the restorationists air defences, allowing the UDF to begin ramping up their attacks.

The restorationists would certainly be caught by surprise, but the missile attacks prior to the amphibious assault would prompt them to deploy a taskforce to patrol the island. The incoming landing party would pick up on their radar in just enough time to deploy a naval armada. Armed with the sheer number and power of their fleet, they would engage the amphibious assault head on. Shots would be fired from the battleships, whilst mines would be laid along the coastline. To combat the incoming aircraft, the restorationists would deploy their limited aerial capabilities against the daesunesians, despite knowing that their aircraft, along with their entire naval fleet would likely be blown out the water by the daesunesian supremacy in the air. The restorationist "counter" to the incoming aerial attack would comprise of 2 A-6s and 4 F-4s.

The isolationists' policy had long been against any foreign involvement in astanir, hence their name. However, the toll of war had begun to take it's effect on the faction, along with the embarrassing defeat to the qianxun-backed democrats. This would lead general Kaiwai to, regrettably, accept talks in Teremok. He would be flown there 2 days later.

The electronic warfare carried out by Daesun would be very effective. Once again, the outdated equipment of the restorationists would be their downfall, causing chaos in the radars, which would hinder the restorationist's naval advances and the targeting systems of their air defences.

[b][u]Nordiheim foreign affair news[/u][/b]

At around mid day on the 17th of october, Erene year 2026, Nordiheim and Maqamistan signed a large and significant agreement between the two nations.

[spoiler=[b]The Nordiheimian and Maqamistan Trade and Friendship Deal of 17th of June 2026[/b]]
[b][u]The Jose Deal[/u][/b]

[b]Trade and Friendship deal between The United Territories of Nordiheim and The Peoples Islamic Republic of Maqamistan[/b]
[i]====================================================[/i]

[i][u]With this deal the two nations of Nordiheim and Maqamistan agree to adhere to the following sections and points:[/u][/i]
[i][u]_A____________________L____________________L____________________A____________________H_[/u][/i]

[b][i][u]Trade Section[/u][/i][/b]
[u][b]1.a:[/b][/u] Both parties agree to open their civilian markets for free trade between each others nations in their entierty.

[u][b]1.b:[/b][/u] All trade are to be done in "good faith" and with fair prices based on world market prices on a quarterly basis.

[u][b]1.c:[/b][/u] If there should be a large change or upset in the world economy the trade prices can be changed outside of the quarterly basis if both nations agree.

[b][u]1.d:[/u][/b] Both nations are allowed to place a tarif of up to 20% on goods and services that they themself also produce/create to protect their own economy and citizens jobbs.

[b][u]1.e:[/u][/b] On goods and services that a nation don't produce/create themself the tariff can be no higher then 5%.

++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++

[b][i][u]Resource Section[/u][/i][/b]
[u][b]2.a:[/b][/u] Nordiheim agrees sell Oil to the nation of Maqamistan in exchange for currency of equal international value.

[b][u]2.b:[/u][/b] All purchase of Oil are to be done in "good faith" and with fair prices based on world market prices on a quarterly basis.

[u][b]2.c:[/b][/u] If there should be a large change or upset in the world economy the price and quantity can be changed outside of the quarterly basis if both nations agree.

[b][u]2.d:[/u][/b] Maqamistan are not allowed to place a tariff on Nordiheimian Oil higher then 5%.

++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++

[b][i][u]Friendship, defence and co-operation.[/u][/i][/b]

[b][u]3.a:[/u][/b] The nations of Nordiheim and Maqamistan agrees on a mutual pact of defence were either nation is to come to the aid of the other in the event that they are attacked by another nation!

[b][u]3.b:[/u][/b] This also binds both nations to a Non Agression Pact towards each other!

[b][u]4:[/u][/b] With the signing of The Jose Time Deal the nations of Nordiheim and Maqamistan singals a mutual declaration of friendship!

[b][u]5:[/u][/b] Both nations will be allowed to open embassies in each others national capitals.

[b][u]6:[/u][/b] To improve and build cultural and social understanding between each other the two nations of Nordiheim and Maqamistan agree to allow for easier travel between their nations for their citizens aswell as allow for student exchange programs to be created and make use of each nations universities and schools of higher learning.

[b][u]7:[/u][/b] In the interest of friendship and co-operation Nordiheim declares a willingness to have the trade deal between them and Maqamistan be open to change and/or new amendments in the future should there be need for it because of changes in either nation or the world scene that have a noticable effect on the original intention of 'The Jose Deal' as long as both parties can arrive at a mutual agreement to such changes.

++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++
[b][i][u]Special Section![/u][/i][/b]

[u][b]8:[/b][/u] Nordiheim or Maqamistan will have the right to terminate this agreement if either nations do the following:
a: Deny access to purchases, or other items outlined to be available to each nation in this deal!
b: Send aid to, supply, or in any way support enemies of either nations such as terrorist groups, pirates, or nations either signatory is actively at war with!
c: Take or declare hostile action or intent against the other signatory of this agreement!
d: Hostile infringement on intelectual propperty owned by the other nation or its companies.
e: Hostile action or declaration of war ageinst a nation whom the other nation have a defence pact with or a duty to defend trough a mutual organization or alliance.

++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++

[i]Signatory parties[/i]

[u][i]The Council of The United Regions of Nordiheim[/i][/u]  ===============  [u][i]Minister Marco ibn Fadlan of The Peoples Islamic Republic of Maqamistan[/i][/u][/spoiler]

This agreement not only involves the flow of trade and culture between the two nations but also a defence treaty, the first one in modern times between Nordiheim and a fellow Argos strait nation.
It is belived that this will not only help both nations prosper, but also open the door for future deals and deeper diplomatic ties between the two countries and promote future stability in the strait.

The diplomat that was in charge of negotiating and closing the deal, Bakir al-Aydin, said in an interview with Nordiheim News that he hopes more such deals can be made with other nations, whose coast is in the Argos strait, to ensure the stability and security in the strait for comercial and civilian ships to allow them all to grow their nation into a prosperous one that their citizens can be happy and proud to live in.
He was later reported to have joined a local mosque for night prayer and to thank Allah for blessing the negotiation with success.
